• Switch cam while reloading

• Boxes: opened some area at C and next to train on Abbey

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
**Patch 0.3.0**

This patch is the one that will be live during our second playtest
If you have not read everything since the last playtest then the following is everything added since our latest playtest!

**Latency updates!**
We improved our latency replication on almost everything.
This means the responsiveness of the player will practically always be the same.
However, when you have higher latency in games for example the damage hit on enemies will still have a delay. (as in all games)

- Set the good latency replication for Run Device functions 
- Set the good latency replication for Toll + switch firing mode
- Set the good latency replication for Climb
- Set the good latency replication for Slide
- Set the good latency replication for Take cover
- Set the good latency replication for Mouse Input / ros get off cover when 90+switch shoulder cam 
- Set the good latency replication for Gun down
- Set the good latency replication for Bane
- Set the good latency replication for Shelter
- Set the good latency replication for Spark
- Set the good latency replication for Fury
- Set the good latency replication for Nade throwing
- Set the good latency replication for Firing
- Fixed climb latency issues + hand IK for climb

**Voice chat**
We now have voice chat in the game (not fully tested)
- Add voice chat key binding
- Left alt for talk
- X for showing the players list, joining the team, get the settings

**Map updates!**
We improved our maps quite a bit.
Minimaps are also working better.

- Fixed some lighting on hld_water
- Improved cq_dam fakewater refraction
- Added physmats to hld_water
- Added a bunch of physmats to office 
- Added a bunch of physmats to cq_cliffside
- Added a bunch of physmats to cq_persia, and 
- Added a bunch of physmats to excavation 
- Fixed some more physmats on cq_abbey
- Fix some bugs on cq_cliffside and ons_mine
- Fixed some physmats on mainmenu 
- Rebuilded mainmenu lighting
- Rebuild tdm_office lighting 
- Tone down grass, metal, tile bullet effects
- Tone down metal sparks
- Fixed minimap renderer display
- Some optimization for cq_excavation minimap
- Updated cq_persia minimap
- Added kill volume component to maps in deadspace

**Device updates!**
A lot of changes have been made to the devices to give them a better balance.
We expect no real unfair behavior during this playtest.

- Shelter hp fix
- Fixed some problems with Shelter

- Fury hit/montage fix/adjustment
- Changed Noise texture for the Fury effect
- Reverted the Fury control back to few patches ago(2.0). Makes it easier to control

- Added Punisher
- Removed Drone
    Punisher works mostly the same as the drone. We felt the drone itself was hard to get working properly. We opted for a variant where we now have a machine gun on our shoulder when the ability is activated.

- Fixed some device charging issues

**Weapons and shooting updates!**
- Added new bullet impact and decals
- Bullet impact decals are now visible from farther away
- Adjusted bullet impact FX

- Some attachment adjustments
- Some weapon accuracy adjustments

- Fixed some bugs to spread of weapons
- Further refined spread response curves
- Adjusted min spread for SMGs
- Changed spread to cone instead of square
- Some balancing for accuracy/spread 

- More accurate crosshairs
- Improved crosshair visual
- Added shotguns crosshair 
- Added aim crosshair and ui option
- Crosshair hides when you can't shoot

- Grenade Indicator - Multiple indicators now appear if the player is inside the radius of multiple grenades.
- Grenade Indicator - The grenade position now updates after being thrown, so the indicator doesn't only point towards the inital position of the grenade anymore
- Grenade Indicator - Fixed bug related to the rotation of the grenade indicator widget, it now rotates properly towards the direction of the grenade
- Adjusted nade indicator
- Fixed bug where grenade would sometimes deal damage to only 1 character standing in its radius

- Fixed input buffering for single-fire
- Set floating dmg to apply dmg 
- Reload cancel adjustment.
- Fixed fire into wall at end of cover (lmb pressed only)
- Fixed sg holes + adjusted aim cam in cover
- Fixed for aim transp. in cover + adjust. ready + reload ui
- Added transparency to head mesh when aiming
- Maybe solve double fire bug
- Fixed using ads in cover
- Fixed shotgun sound bug where there was no sound when you put a silencer on the gun
- Fixed bug where grenade would clip underneath the floor, causing it to not deal damage to anyone
- Aim down fixes
- Aim up fixes
- Fixed Sniper reload bug 
- Fixed Rapid-fire bug issue
- Sniper bolt adjustment
- Adjusted sniper sway in and out of cover
- Adjusted lean around corner
- Adjusted firing animation
- Adjusted aiming in cover
- Enabled aim + shoot in prone
- Set snipers sway when walk, aim and shoot
- Fixed roll and ADS problems
- Adjusted sniper's recoil
- adjusted weapon scopes location for rpk,type95,vhs


**Movement and other updates!**
- Disabled xmas stuff
- Run to fall+prone fixed
- Some small bug fixes
- Fix keybindings reset on new game
- Fixed double attach sound in mainmenu
- Fix for aim transp. in cover + adjust. ready + reload ui
- Projectile size + cover in fix
- Enabled animations to lean around corners when in cover
- set look around the corner with A+D
- Set some extra information for cover title to show changes in stats
- Fixed cam issues when take off cover
- Fixed some bugs that where hindering shooting
- set to be able to chat/check the scoreboard during dead
- Fixed an issue with the camera
- Possible fix for capture UI not showing up
- Fixed problems with damage UI not always showing up
- Fixed multriple issues with sounds not correctly playing
- Fixed the impact effect
- Fixed some damage UI problem
- Fixed some UI problems
- Fixed some problems with the X icon 
- Added play scan ready sound effect
- Fixed some cursor issues
- Fixed some cam issues
- Scan detect icon + text
- Chat is now visible while being dead
- Scoreboard is now visible while being dead
- Some small bug fixes
- Changed some bugged animations to new ones
- Disabled take cover filter and set to aim precisly where the crosshair is
- Fixed issue where cam stayed up
- Adjusted some things to help with lagg problems
- Added device selection in main menu v2
- Added Voice chat v1
- Fixed issues with sway+run, crouch, prone combo
- Fix for keybinding not registering on 2nd game
- Set playtest ID 
- Fixed cover rotation bugs
- Adjusted device selection ui

notes.title: Major update 0.2.0 is here!
notes.content:
Welcome to the 0.2.0 patch notes!
This is the patch that will be run on the playtest and since last patch notes there is a lot to cover.
We will split the things in different sections. Fixed bugs, Adjusted and New things.


Things that have been fixed:
- Many small fixes which will make the list to long to make. These where around 120..
- Weapon issues in the main menu/ingame as characters where holding wrong weapons/weapon sizes
- Loading weapons attachments ingame as client, V1 to V4 were not a solution so V5 is. Attachments now work on the client side.
- Possible fix for 1 of our main crash (working so far)
- Forbid climbing on objects where we should not.
- Fix where slide speed was not as intended
- Movement speed issues where players did not get the correct speed at certain times.
- Handguns issues where gun was not functioning properly
- Emp nade issues where the nade was not doing anything.
- Can't join the server or host match after the previous one got disbanded or destroyed (even if the host force closed match/game)
- Stuck at loading screen as client
- Disabled Fsr2 due to it giving a lot of problems.
- Lobby team issues (these where many)
- Spawning in the correct team
- Some code optimization
- Sighting rebuild
- Sobby name issues
- Scoreboard update
- Playing duplicated sounds for clients
- Minimap points colors
- Tdm scores+ui colors
- Fixed fury hit montages + camera
- Changed Acog scope mesh/materials
- Ready time resetting while firing after you stop running.
- Player camera not going properly aiming down to the character when hit by fury
- Capture sounds started playing when 1v1 and didn’t stop when capturing or dying on capture zone
- Capture points not resetting correctly 
- Ammo pickup sound being duplicated
- Fixed issue where reloading UI stayed on screen when hit by Fury
- Fixed by where an empty kill log was seen as white boxes.
- Point resetting
- End round/match point flags
- Get selected teams in the game from the lobby
- Capture progress bar + sound fix 
- Remained default kill log
- Materials for some weapons
- Client sniper scopes
- Capture bar+sound disappearing
- New player registering 
- Teleport at a slim object and A/D pressing while the cam is in character
- Overtime and captured point time together goes to minus
- floating name fix v1 (enemy can see player name+bar)
- Set restrict when buying stuff grant for owner class only
- Fixed server browser match finding issue
- Fix for problem where host couldn’t host another match after previously disbanding one.
- Fixed juggernaut effect to be less in your face
- Fixed lobby issues
-Fixed some drone issues
-fixed Nade throwing issues 
- match result fix
- spawn camera on some maps
- reduce mine ambiance to 75% volume
- sound issues + set sounds as attached when needed
- save selected class when someone leaves the lobby

Map fixing:
- Cq_cliffside optimization/minimap optimization
- A bunch of cq_excavation collision bugs
- Cq_abbey capture points
- Some cq_abbey optimization and bug fixes
- minimap fixes for m.s. echo


Things that have been adjusted
Adjusted:
- 30% more bullet spread when non ADS
- Cover adjustments
- Tutorial map update
- Getting hit responding
- Updated kill log
- Some UI (color + positions)
- Spectator free cam for everyone , num5 to activate, num4 previous,num6 next player view
-**Color response** >> Red color is always about the enemy's team, our green is our team:
- Killer/victim in kill log
- Capturing progress bar + progress %
- Capture floating-point letters
- Amount players on actual capture points (yours vs the enemy team)
- Capture point floor color (even when ongoing capture)
- Scoreboard (seems like we are always in the green team)
- Main top capture point letters
- Lobby panels
- Winning team X1.2 score at the end of the match
- Increased the respawn timer from 3 to 6 seconds
- Clients now can better feel the recoil.
- Made top right UI smaller.
- Disable shoulder switch while bolt pull to prevent bolt pull from getting stuck and the player unable to shoot
- Visibility when the player used Fury.
- Run speed 600 >> 520 
- Delay for ready to spawn 3 >> 6 secs 
- Cancel reload by R disabled
- Optimize cq_abbey minimap
-ui words scale
-chat new line for long message + scrolling possibility + last line seeing
-some minimap update
-server browser menu
-team change always on in lobby
-6v6 max players
- We built the shipment version of the game what means: 
This is the configuration for optimal performance and shipping your game.
This configuration strips out console commands, stats, and profiling tools.
- Normal firing can be heard more further
- Cover title

Devices:

- Drone
	Longer shoot distance was 1700(18m) now 2400(24m)
	Increased fire rate. 170 -> 300
	Duration increased 15 -> 20 seconds
	Set damage calculations the same as weapons -15
	Show floating damage numbers
	Increased hp. 250 –> 400
	

- Shelter
	Increase width and height.
	Reduced spawn time to 0 (instant)
	Increased duration from 10 –> 15 seconds
	Doubled health regeneration
	Disabled the shelter wall disable function when pressing F again.

- Spark
	No time slow for teammates anymore
	Increased duration from 3 -> 6 seconds.
Decreased spawning time by 25%

- Fury: 
Reduce duration from 10 -> 8 seconds
	Reduce knockdown time to 2.5 seconds instead of 5 seconds
Reduce damage from 75 -> 30

-scan 
will not reset upon respawn, except round/warmup start (similar remaining like device power)


New things:
- Quick scan game var, add effects to Bane and smoke Nade
- New reload canceling
- Missing sounds for weapons/ingame
- Some voices for certain actions
- Hud color to our main color theme
- Ddesert weapon pack:
*new weapon m200S
*new weapon Type95S
*new weapon Vhs-K2S
- New hit marker
- Cant shoot X icon
- After reload pull sound (different for each weapon)
- Adjusted eliminated ui
- Providing virtual currency for clients at end of match (also extra UC when leveling up),details:

end of match UC amount = own total score OR
extra UC amount for leveling up = own total score + new level * 5000
for example:
own total score:10.000
lvl:20
(10.000*20)+5000=25.000 UC

- New chat system
- More missing sounds/music
- Capture points to the minimap
- Scoreboard points visually show up/checking at the end of rounds, win depends on the amount of total captured points now, match can be a draw/tie too
- Sounds for match 
- Capture zone to the minimap
- Holographic sight
- Remained overtime counter on the scoreboard
- 2 overtimes/round
- Overtime happens only if a point is being captured by an enemy, resetting an own point won't be counted!
- Limited 15 mins/round (max match time is 30 mins + some overtime possibilities)
- No added extra time for captured points or overtime if the round/match reaches the max round/match time
- Add minimap icons rendering
- Showing selected stuff in the main menu for classes
- Permanent outline for teammates (not for enemy, even when scanned)
- Run should cancel reload
- Reload should cancel the run
- played time on the leaderboard
- outline of enemies now visible when using scan
-  Added Intro and TOF
- minimap icons visibility for teammates/shooting enemy,showing correctly now (not totally done)
- client can see everything as well on the minimap

notes.title: Update 0.1.0 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517244/f756a8a773190e556443dc0ae59b885937ae758a.png[/img]

Network update for clients:

-Climb
-Run
-Crouch
-Prone
-Cover
-Switch shoulder camera and A / D button
-Switch firing mode
-Sliding
-SwitchWeapon
-GrenadeThrowing
-DisableInputs/cover

Overal movement for the clients should be smoother.


Changes and fixes:
- Damage numbers changed from blue to yellow (better visibility)
- Lean cam should be same speed as the lean camera.
- Kill cam should not go up after death anymore
- Player should not be taking cover at random anymore
- Orange outline is gone. You won't secretly see enemies anymore when they are close together.
- Player will have a sound when landing.
- Nade throw was slowed down. Now it should always have the correct speed.
- reload warn sound could be heard by other players. This is not for player only.
- Weapon swapping was sometimes slow. This should be faster.
- Drone activation was deemed to slow. This is faster.
- Dead enemy should not be visible anymore. 
- Spark remained on the field after player died. This should not happen anymore.
- Cover title sometimes remained to be seen even when far from the wall. Player will now only see it when being in certain distance of an object/wall.
- Running was sometimes laggy. This should be fixess.
- RPK was to strong. Numbers have been dialed down for more fair gameplay.
- Removed the red dot from the non ADS crosshair.
- Ready time from running to fire sometimes seemed to much. This is lowered overall.
- Slide to cover cam client is improved.
- On client side the cover title remained when sliding into cover. Now it will properly dissapear.
- It was not possible to run out of cover for both client and host. Now we should be able to.
- Fixed weird hand movement when walking away from cover while chaning shoulder.
- Improved fire rate for handguns
- Fixed the temp class changing weapons destroying
- Fury should be less laggy.
- Capture sound kept playing after dieing on a capture point. Fix makes it so person stops hearing capture sound when dieing on point.
- When a lot of people where in a lobby we couldnt choose teams anymore. This will be fixed.
- Fixed a reload sound bug.
- be more queit shooting and reload sound (hearing so far dist)
- disable cloak print
- shoot sound can be hear closer
- slide to cover cam client fix
- cover trace for diff object line
- Crouching has a 0.4 delay before using again. No more spamming.
- gun down anim remains from prone or in cover taking fix
- from prone and switched cam on left to cover hand issue
- slide to cover gun down anim remains fix 
- take cover hand ik off in switched
- client aim and take off cover cowboy
- others device icons not middle fix
- 3 secs respawn delay
- Sound of no more ammo should not be playing at full ammo capacity anymore
- New reload animations for pistol and shotguns
- Only see your own marker
- No more dolphin diving
- Changes to sliding speed (revert)
- Cancel reload when pressing R during reload animation

Devices:
- Drone: +30%range +20% Higher fire rate? Faster activation
- Spark: Faster activation
- Fury: Knock more than 1 player
- Shelter: Longer lifetime 10 -> 15 seconds
- Pathfinder: 20% shorter lifetime
- Bane: Faster activation, New trajectory, Now 1 press of F is on urself, hold it for longer distance up to 3 seconds
- Device charge should not be resetting after spawn anymore

Possible fixes (uncertain):
- Nade sometimes was not availabe on spawning. Now the nade should always be available on respawning
- Client got default attachments on their weapon. Now players should properly get their chosen attachments
- slide to cover stand

Other notable things:
- Lobby fixes
- CQ_Cliffside fixes
- CQ_Dam Misc fixes
- Minimap for all maps and visual changes.
- Conquest VAR in lobby
- Fixed some UI bugs
- Video setting should be saved upon restart
- Changed keybindings should not be shown ingame on the HUD
- Changing upscaling from FSR2 to DLSS should not crash anymore
- Camo button is disabled
- TDM_Echo now has temporary team based spawn points.
